meta.title: Recreate with a Custom end time of 90 minutes

plan.title: Recreate Order with 90-Minute Custom End Time

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly as the buyer.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order dialog.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order dialog, choose Custom under Event End Time Duration, enter 90 minutes, click Create Order, and stop when the recreated event screen proves its end time is 90 minutes after its start

steps.note: Perform the custom duration entry and creation, verifying the resulting event schedule on screen.
Confirm the recreated order completed without an application error.
